title: Cap. VI Arg. 11 close: Arminian order is Postdestinatio, not Praedestinatio
pass_a_gloss: If no other argument were at hand for us, this one alone could abundantly break and overturn that Arminian predestination, that it sets men down as predestinated to eternal life only then, when they have arrived at it itself, all difficulties and dangers having been overcome: which may more rightly be called Postdestination than Predestination.
pass_b_english: Even if we had no other argument, this alone would amply shatter that Arminian predestination: it has men predestined to eternal life only once they have already arrived, every difficulty and danger overcome. That is more rightly called Postdestination than Predestination.
source_text: Si nullum aliud argumentum suppeteret nobis, hoc unicum abunde infringere et evertere posset illam praedestinationem Arminianam, quod homines ponat tum demum ad vitam aeternam praedestinari, cum ad ipsam, superatis omnibus difficultatibus et periculis, pervenerint: quae rectius Postdestinatio quam Praedestinatio dicatur.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. VI Arg. 11 section 487. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap6_arg11_densify. Honest partial.
